{{Top|leg}}
The '''Director of Mid Rim Operations''' was a position in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. They would oversee the [[Mid Rim Operations Group]], directing all SIS operations in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Ardun Kothe]] served in this position during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
